pipeline/01_acquisition/acquisition.py.note: Actual normalize_width output; display panels share a size, pixel dimensions differ.

pipeline/02_enhancement/histogram.py.note: A measurement module: input image and computed histogram, not an enhanced image.

pipeline/02_enhancement/point_operations.note: All panels use the same display range 0-255; brightness changes are not autoscaled.

contrast_stretch_example.note: Supplementary controlled example: input = floor(reference * 0.25 + 45); fixed display range 0-255.

pipeline/02_enhancement/histogram_mappin.note: Matching uses the displayed reference; equalization uses the input distribution.

pipeline/02_enhancement/spatial_filters..note: Seed 132; salt/pepper probabilities 3.5% each; identical noisy input for every filter.

pipeline/03_segmentation/segmentation.py.note: Hue 0 +/- 20 degrees; saturation >= 60, value >= 40; morphology kernel 3.

pipeline/04_features/color_palette.py.note: Four-color synthetic fixture; bar lengths are computed pixel proportions.

pipeline/04_features/feature_vector.py.note: Indices 0-23: 8-bin B/G/R histograms; 24-27: normalized grayscale statistics.

pipeline/04_features/auto_tag.py.note: Rule-based metadata only; image pixels are unchanged. This is not an accuracy evaluation.

reasons.cool: Cool-hue pixels are 78.2% of chromatic pixels, at least the 50% threshold.

pipeline/05_evaluation/quality_metrics.p.note: Scores use the clean reference, not the noisy input; this is one controlled example.

pipeline/05_evaluation/segmentation_metr.note: IoU 0.712; precision 0.832; recall 0.832. Synthetic mask pair, not real annotation.

pipeline/05_evaluation/benchmark_baselin.note: Local measured timing; varies by machine. Max output difference: 0.000092.
